question: In a certain code language, 'SHOULD' is coded as ' AIRLEP'. What is the code for 'WIDELY' in that code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'SHOULD' is coded as ' AIRLEP',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/67df233dddc30286ab91e931a7b89a936e6752ecf69dde56f85ac9e72510e1c0.png] 

Similarly, for 'WIDELY'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76ecacb522218a4a0b6818ee783494d6bdfceb19fbcfd878cb5db828b665e722.png] 

So, 'WIDELY' is coded as 'VIBAFT'.
